title: FemTheme Solo #016 · 여 블랙 글래머·스페인플라멩코글램·닌자 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a serene Japanese garden with raked pale gravel, a stone path, a low wooden bridge with a waist-high rail and a standard-height wooden gate, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Spanish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a bronze hammer head, a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver anklets. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black ninja headband with a polished steel plate across her forehead, black fingerless wrist wraps and a red sash tied at one hip, a micro strapless black bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal black micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme black ballet heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining every figure, each material catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
